generationInputs.prompt:
BASE PROMPT — ACCIDENTAL ANIMAL SELFIE

An extremely ordinary and non-artistic selfie photograph, taken with an iPhone accidentally and clumsily. The image has a chaotic composition, awkward framing, slight overexposure due to uneven lighting, and a subtle motion blur, as if the phone was pulled out of a pocket by accident. The aesthetic should feel absurdly casual and mediocre, like a spontaneous and poorly taken photo.

The main subject is the animal from the reference image uploaded by the user, clearly maintaining its real features, fur, colors, and facial shape. The animal has its mouth open with an exaggerated expression of surprise, excitement, or a comical scream. The expression should be funny, chaotic, and very natural, as if it were reacting intensely to the moment.

The photo should look like a real selfie taken by the animal itself, with a crooked angle, cut-off parts of the face or body, inconsistent lighting, and an authentic feeling of an accidental snapshot.

Hyperrealistic style, casual mobile photography, imperfect aesthetic, chaotic energy, appearance of an impromptu capture.
